call the inner release port 0x0062c340 only when +0xc8 is non-null

runtime_gates: the receiver class is unresolved; the target reads and clears only the five holder slots and the blend at +0x3588
0x0062c340 is a dependency-only port, so the inner release is unverified in this package
the global holder at 0x015f7cf4 is a program global whose owner is unresolved
the +0xcc release and the +0x3588 release are unconditional, so both dereference their vtable without a null guard
decompilation_defects_corrected: the decompilation reports five calls; the assembly has six dispatch sites because the 0x0062c340 port is reached through the runtime struct and so compiles as an indirect call rather than a direct one
the decompilation renders the last release as a call followed by the epilogue; the assembly at 0x0062c977 is pop edi; pop esi; jmp edx, so it is a tail transfer and the model keeps it last
